description.en: A 21.7 km section of the A1 motorway on Corridor Vc between Medakovo and Ozimice.
description.ro: Un tronson de 21,7 km al autostrazii A1 de pe Coridorul Vc, intre Medakovo si Ozimice.

contractors.name: Cengiz Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.

note.en: The Q3 2025 report gives 21.7 km and reports construction underway. Cengiz Insaat signed the EUR 361.7533555 million contract excluding VAT on 9 March 2023. The OSM line is about 21.86 km, drawn between the nearest mapped A1 construction points to Medakovo and Ozimice; recorded length follows the project source.
note.ro: Raportul din trimestrul III 2025 indica 21,7 km si lucrari in curs. Cengiz Insaat a semnat contractul de 361,7533555 milioane EUR fara TVA la 9 martie 2023. Linia OSM are aproximativ 21,86 km, trasata intre punctele de constructie A1 cartografiate cele mai apropiate de Medakovo si Ozimice; lungimea inregistrata urmeaza sursa proiectului.
